draft.subject: Planning the annual family distributions
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

With the next of the annual distributions to family beneficiaries due in December 2026, I would like to make sure each payment is planned for, not only covered. Each distribution is USD 3,200,000, about 4% of your wealth with us, and they continue every year until 2045.

The amount is well within the family's means. What I would like to settle is where each year's payment comes from, so that it is never met by selling something at an awkward moment, particularly in a year when capital calls fall due as well.

What I would suggest is that we agree a standing arrangement for funding the distributions, and review it once a year alongside the private markets commitments.

Could we arrange a call this week?
